summary: Strong Python practices (type hints, dataclasses, custom exceptions, exit codes). Workflow well-structured with proper permissions (read-only), pinned actions, sensible triggers, and matrix organization. Main concerns: PROJECT_FILES list in run_act_tests.py requires manual maintenance; EXPECTED output signatures (run_act_tests.py:46–79) must stay in sync with render_plan() format (artifact_cleanup.py:195–210) or tests drift; regex for job grouping (run_act_tests.py:113–124) is fragile. Error handling is comprehensive but test harness lacks retry/recovery. No actionlint validation errors visible; scripts are well-commented and deterministic.
